title: Cloud Deployment Pipeline
description: A continuous integration and edge release runner displaying step progress (Build, Test, Deploy, Verify).
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Rail
Density: Compact
Shape: Rounded
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Monospace
Color: Accent Only

## Rules

- Ci Pipeline Stage Tracking: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
